description: Search the team's approved memory for a repo (rules, architecture, commands, decisions, risks, past failures). Call it while planning — with a one-line summary of what you intend to do — and before non-trivial changes. Results marked 'replaces' are the current decision.

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default 10)

query.description: What to search for, e.g. a one-line summary of the planned change

repo.description: This repo's git remote or owner/name, e.g. 'BenjaminBeguin/memmo'. Call list_repos if unsure.

name: search_memory
title: Search Memmo memory
